name: exactly two users remain after delete
description: The harness calls solve(conn), then asserts the total row count. Charlie (inactive) must have been deleted, leaving Alice and Bob.

name: Alice's email is updated
description: The harness asserts the email column for Alice after solve(conn) returns.
assertQuery: SELECT email FROM users WHERE name = 'Alice'

name: no inactive users remain
description: All rows with active=FALSE must have been removed by the user's Java JDBC delete statement.
assertQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE active = FALSE

name: active users have correct names and emails
description: The harness runs an ORDER BY query after solve(conn) and compares all columns row-by-row.
assertQuery: SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY name
